pet_bloop.name: Bloop
pet_bloop.desc: Bloop, Bryony's glowing frog (The Cold Cauldron): a small teal-green frog with a pale belly, big shy eyes, a tiny smile and cold-blue glowing freckles on his brow and back; amber forge light on one side; sits by the Forge Quarter vents, hops when he follows

petfx.look: NEON blue glow freckles and throat in bloop_neon.png (primary); bloop.png is palette-safe (sky / flower_blue / cloth), same layout

pet_bloop.story: forge_alchemy.md 7.6: found at Tova's quench tank (flag is `cc_bloop`); talkable; sits near the Forge Quarter vents; hops when following
